topic: My child won't sleep without me
video_title: My child won't sleep without me: what to do tonight (ages 2-6)
caption:
My child won't fall asleep unless I lie down with them.

If your 2–6 year old won't sleep without you, try this tonight:
1. Keep the same calm routine, in the same order, every night.
2. Say goodnight while they're sleepy, so they learn to fall asleep alone.
3. If they get up, lead them back calmly, with no lecture and very few words.
